summary: Phase 0 retry acceptance is not warranted. Focused retry and scaffold suites pass and the receipt-hash guard passes, but the retry lacks authentic independent task-event provenance, required Phase 0A rejected-evidence/live-verifier artifacts, and a passing marker-vocabulary aggregate. The designated primary orchestrator is recorded only as product-owner authorization; no product-owner acceptance event is asserted.

blocking_findings.title: Independent task-event provenance is absent
blocking_findings.evidence: measure/tests/evidence_integrity_gates/role-receipts/phase0.json records NOT_FABRICATED for spawn_id, parent_id, start_event_id, end_event_id, and final_response_hash; it also records measure-mid-red as the sole author and defers counterexample and adversarial-review roles. This cannot satisfy FR3 or the Phase 0 closeout requirement for distinct, tool-attested roles.

blocking_findings.title: Required unavailable-attestation retry artifacts and live proof are missing
blocking_findings.evidence: test-strategy.md requires phase0-retry-rejected-evidence.json, test_phase0_retry_provenance, and measure.evidence_integrity_gates.phase0_retry_verify for Retry Phase 0A. None exists at reviewed SHA 535bfdfe. The strategy requires a structured blocked result and stop when live task-event resolution is unavailable, but the receipt contains placeholders without authentic resolver evidence.

blocking_findings.title: Retry did not meet its one-implementation-commit boundary
blocking_findings.evidence: git rev-list --count 5103c24b..535bfdfe returns 2 (75a12493 and 535bfdfe), while test-strategy.md requires exactly one post-baseline commit for Retry Phase 0C. Git author identity is not role-event provenance and does not cure P0-RETRY-ACCEPT-001.

blocking_findings.title: Marker-vocabulary aggregate remains failing
blocking_findings.evidence: bash tests/orchestrator_marker_vocabulary.sh exits 1 because active plans retain deprecated [ ] markers. The test strategy requires this aggregate failure to remain visible and forbids describing it as a pass.

blocking_findings.title: Prior independent security review remains blocked on the same provenance requirement
blocking_findings.evidence: review-b-security-result.json is BLOCKED and leaves APK-EIG-B-005 (High, authentic independent role provenance absent) and APK-EIG-B-006 (Medium, shared aggregate gates red) open and blocking.

nonblocking_findings: The retry semantic suite passes 23 tests, the existing scaffold suite passes 46 tests, and tests/orchestrator_role_receipt_integrity.sh reports current enumerated output hashes match HEAD. Hash consistency does not authenticate the role, event, ancestry, context, or final response.

User authorization: the primary orchestrator is designated as product owner. This is recorded as owner authorization only; no tool-generated product-owner event ID, message hash, approval timestamp, or acceptance transition is claimed.

evidence.detail: Authentic tool-attested role receipts and a product-owner event are required; Phase 0 has neither.
The plan explicitly states authentic distinct-role provenance is unavailable and Phase 0 remains incomplete.
The prior failed/blocked acceptance artifacts are preserved evidence, not completion evidence.
Placeholder provenance is present and deferred roles admit that independent authorship was not achieved.
The retry range 5103c24b..535bfdfe contains two commits, not the strategy's required one.

commands.result: PASS: current enumerated output hashes match HEAD
FAIL: active plans retain deprecated [ ] markers
diff check PASS; commit count FAILS retry requirement (2, expected 1)

test_strategy_violations: Retry Phase 0A's rejected-evidence ledger, provenance suite, and live attestation verifier are absent.
The unavailable-attestation preflight required a structured blocked result and stop; no authentic task-event resolver proof exists.
Retry Phase 0C requires exactly one commit from 5103c24b through the reviewed retry head; the range has two.
live_contract_violations: No real collaboration-event export or resolver validates distinct role IDs, ancestry, fork_turns=none review, context, chronology, final-response hash, or output ownership.
The marker-vocabulary aggregate is failing; it cannot be represented as a passing aggregate gate.
